info.name: WeatherIQ — Smart Weather Alerts API
info.description:
Member 4 API collection for the Smart Weather Alerts module.
Endpoints: GET /api/alerts, GET /api/alerts/:locationId, POST /api/alerts/generate, DELETE /api/alerts/:id

Expected base URL: http://localhost:3000

response.name: 200 OK — server is running
201 Created — new alerts generated
200 OK — all skipped (duplicates already exist)
500 Internal — DB connection failed
200 OK — alerts sorted Critical → High → Medium → Low
